description: Turn a plain PDF (public URL) into a NEW brand-designed document carousel. The document is read, planned as one idea per slide, designed in the account's brand (colours, fonts, logo, brand guidelines) and rendered as a fresh PDF — published as a LinkedIn document post; Instagram can be added at publish time and gets the same slides as an image carousel. Use this when the user wants a PDF redesigned or turned into a carousel rather than posted as-is (that is create_document_post). LinkedIn must be connected; if not, the tool returns a connect link to give the user. Runs in the background for a few minutes — poll get_task_status with the returned taskId.

context.description: What the document is about or what to emphasise — improves the slide plan and the caption

createCarousel.description: Also create a SEPARATE Instagram carousel post right now. Default false — Instagram is normally added at publish time, the slides then go out there as an image carousel.

documentUrl.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the source PDF

productId.description: Optional product the deck is about, as 'shopify-42' or 'feed-17' (from list_products). Adds product details and a product photo to the design.

title.description: Deck title, shown on the LinkedIn document card. Defaults to what the document itself says.

name: redesign_document
title: Redesign Document (PDF → branded carousel)
